source.title: Validation is the central challenge for generative social simulation: a critical review of LLMs in agent-based modeling

study.population: Eligible papers in the authors’ systematic review

claim: The review identifies an operational-validity gap; plausibility assessment alone is not enough.

outcome.name: Validation practice relative to stated modeling purpose
outcome.window: Literature search window of the review, not all subsequent work

limitations: A review is not an independent replication of every included study.
Coverage is limited by selection criteria and search dates.
This is not evidence that all social simulation fails.
